name: @oh-my-dsh/stent-pack
description: Stent/Mixin extension workspace: installable profile bundle carrier over the stent package trio

scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.pack:build: pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent run build && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-api run build && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-dsh run build && pnpm run build
scripts.pack:fmt:check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent run fmt:check && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-api run fmt:check && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-dsh run fmt:check
scripts.pack:lint: pnpm run lint && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent run lint && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-api run lint && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-dsh run lint
scripts.pack:knip: pnpm run knip && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent run knip && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-api run knip && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-dsh run knip
scripts.pack:test: pnpm run test && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent run test && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-api run test && pnpm --filter @oh-my-dsh/stent-dsh run test
